summary: Iter31 Founders Benefits — BACKEND 100% (14/14 pytest) and FRONTEND 100% (6/6 Playwright flows on 390x844 mobile viewport). Backend: GET /api/founders returns {total, items[id, first_name, username, avatar, founder_number, suburb, created_at]} sorted asc by founder_number with no _id / password_hash leak; GET /api/founders/status returns {cap:500, taken, remaining, open} with the math consistent (remaining=cap-taken, open=taken<cap). GET /api/groups contains a 'Founders Lounge' group with is_founder_only=true and every existing founder id in members[]. GET /api/tables contains a 'Founders Lounge' table with founder_only=true, persistent=true, real host_id (founder #1 = Alice ac9c70fd…), and all founders in seated[]. Founder-only join guards: POST /api/tables/{fl_id}/join/{non_founder=maggie} → 403 with detail.code='founder_only'; POST /api/tables/{fl_id}/join/{founder} → 200 {ok:true}; same behaviour on /api/groups/{fl_id}/join/{user}. Auto-enrolment at signup: POSTed /api/auth/signup with a random TEST_iter31_<hex> username — response carried is_founder=true, founder_number=3 (=pre_taken+1), badges contains 'Founding Member'. GET /api/users/<new_id> persists the founder fields. The new user was added to Founders Lounge group members[], seated at Founders Lounge table, and received BOTH a 'Welcome to YouBelong!' + a '🦋 You're Founding Member #3!' notification at /api/notifications/{id}. /api/founders/status incremented from 2 → 3 immediately. Frontend (Playwright on http://localhost:3000, viewport 390x844): (1) Welcome / shows the gold banner '🦋 497 Founding Member places remaining. Tap to see the Founders Wall · Free during testing.' — tapping navigates to /founders ✅. (2) /founders shows hero card '3 of 500 early members shaping YouBelong together. FREE DURING TESTING' with three #N pills (#1 Alice, #2 Bob, #3 TEST_iter31) ✅. (3) Home tab after Maggie demo-login renders a gold 'FOUNDERS WALL' card with copy 'Meet the 3 Founding Members shaping YouBelong'; tapping navigates to /founders ✅. (4) Profile tab shows the 'FOUNDERS WALL' gold pill row between Edit Profile and Share YouBelong — tap → /founders ✅. (5) /lounge as Maggie (non-founder): 'Founders Lounge' card sits at the top with the gold border, '🦋 FOUNDERS' badge next to the name, and a '🦋 Founders Only' gold button. Tapping the card opens the modal titled 'Founders Lounge', copy mentions 'just for Founding Members — the first 500 people to join YouBelong', with both 'See the Founders Wall' and 'Maybe later' buttons; 'See the Founders Wall' navigates to /founders ✅. (6) /groups as Maggie: 'Founders Lounge' group row appears at the top with gold border + '🦋 FOUNDERS' badge + gold 'Founders' button. Both the row tap and the 'Founders' button tap navigate to /founders (group does not open) ✅. Cleanup: deleted the TEST_iter31_57495828 user + its notifications + pulled the id from Founders Lounge group/table arrays; founders count restored to 2 (Alice, Bob).
critical_code_review_comments: _assign_founder_status uses a non-transactional count_documents → insert window; under burst load the cohort can overshoot the 500 cap by a few (the doc-comment already calls this out and accepts it for MVP). When traffic ramps, consider replacing with `findOneAndUpdate` on a singleton counter doc + atomic $inc to make the cap exact.

_ensure_founders_table seats the first founder (`host_id`) before the rest are backfilled at startup; correctly idempotent, but if the first founder is later deleted, host_id stays a dangling id. Low impact since founder deletion isn't a UX path, but consider a re-attribution step in the startup backfill.

The frontend gates the Lounge/Groups Founders cards to navigate to /founders for non-founders — good UX for the social-proof story. Make sure founders themselves get the actual join/open behaviour so the perk is real (we did not log in as a founder to verify, since Maggie/demo accounts are explicitly non-founders by design — consider a Playwright pass after a real /auth/signup once you have a smoke-test founder identity).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 real user via /api/auth/signup (username TEST_iter31_57495828) which auto-enrolled as founder #3 in the Founders Lounge group + table. Cleaned up after the run: user deleted, related notifications deleted, founder id pulled from group.members & table.seated. Founders count restored to 2 (Alice fw_test_alice, Bob fw_test_bob).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two seeded founders (Alice #1 host of the table, Bob #2) live in the DB from a previous iteration — leave them in place; they make the social-proof UX render with non-zero counts on the Welcome banner, Home FW card and Wall hero. Founders Lounge group id and table id are stable across signups (created once, idempotent ensure() at startup). The non-founder join guard returns a structured detail of {code:'founder_only'} — assert on detail.code if the FastAPI version preserves the dict; some older clients flatten it to a string, so a fallback `'founder_only' in str(detail)` is recommended.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no regressions or bugs found in this iteration.
